plans.name: Claude Pro
plans.limits: 5-hour session limit + weekly limit; Opus and Sonnet in Claude Code. Fable only via usage credits.
plans.note: $17/mo if billed annually. Anthropic does not publish token or dollar allotments, only multiples (Max = 5x / 20x Pro).

plans.name: Claude Max 5x
plans.limits: 5x Pro per-session allowance + weekly cap. Fable at 50% of weekly limits. Priority access at peak.
plans.note: Also includes monthly API credits (amount not verified, not counted here).

plans.name: Claude Max 20x
plans.limits: 20x Pro per-session allowance + weekly cap. Fable at 50% of weekly limits. Priority access at peak.
plans.note: Widest uncertainty of any plan here: heavy agentic users report far more API-equivalent usage than light users. Use the override box with your own numbers.

plans.name: ChatGPT Go
plans.limits: GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app (subject to rollout).
plans.note: Lightweight coding tier. Cheap model, so dollars stretch far in tokens but not in intelligence.

plans.name: ChatGPT Plus (Codex)
plans.limits: Local messages per 5h: Astra 5-45, GPT-6.1 Sol 15-160, Luna 350-3,000. Weekly limits may apply. Buy credits to extend.
plans.note: OpenAI states message ranges, not dollars. Estimate assumes mostly GPT-6.1 Sol usage at typical agentic task sizes (2-15 credits per task).

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro $100
plans.limits: Pro plans currently have no 5-hour limit; weekly limits apply. Higher multiples of Plus.
plans.note: OpenAI does not publish the Pro multiples on the pricing page; estimate scales from Plus.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro $200
plans.limits: No 5-hour limit; weekly limits apply.
plans.note: Estimate scales from Plus; see methodology.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro $500
plans.limits: Adds Ultrafast mode (burns included usage at 8x Standard for Astra / Sol).
plans.note: Ultrafast consumes allowance faster, so tokens per dollar at Ultrafast are lower than the headline.

plans.name: Cursor Pro
plans.limits: Two pools: Cursor Models (Grok, Composer; 'significantly more' usage) and Other Models (billed at API price). On-demand at API rates after.
plans.note: Cursor's page confirms price and pool structure but not the per-tier dollar amount. $20/$70/$400 follows Cursor's earlier published tiers; the 'high' case credits extra Cursor-Models-pool usage.

plans.name: Cursor Pro+
plans.limits: Recommended by Cursor for daily agent users (typical total usage $60-$100/mo).
plans.note: See Cursor Pro note.

plans.name: Cursor Ultra
plans.limits: Recommended for agent power users (often $200+/mo total usage).
plans.note: See Cursor Pro note.

plans.name: Copilot Pro
plans.limits: $15 of GitHub AI Credits ($10 base + $5 flex). 1 credit = $0.01. Completions unlimited and free of credits.
plans.note: Flex allotment may change over time. Extra usage billed at $0.01/credit.

plans.name: Copilot Pro+
plans.limits: $70 of GitHub AI Credits ($39 base + $31 flex). Adds Claude Fable models.
plans.note: Flex allotment may change over time.

plans.name: Copilot Max
plans.limits: $200 of GitHub AI Credits ($100 base + $100 flex). Built for sustained agent-driven workflows.
plans.note: Flex allotment may change over time.

plans.name: Kiro Pro
plans.limits: 1,000 credits/mo; add-on credits $0.04 each. Valued at the add-on rate.
plans.note: Credit-to-token mapping is not published, so value is measured at Kiro's own retail credit price. Models: Auto, Claude Sonnet 5 / Opus 5, GPT-5.6, open-weight models.

plans.name: Kiro Pro+
plans.limits: 2,000 credits/mo at $0.04 add-on rate.
plans.note: See Kiro Pro note.

plans.name: Kiro Pro Max
plans.limits: 5,000 credits/mo at $0.04 add-on rate.
plans.note: See Kiro Pro note.

plans.name: Kiro Power
plans.limits: 10,000 credits/mo at $0.04 add-on rate.
plans.note: See Kiro Pro note.

plans.name: Devin / Windsurf Pro
plans.limits: Quota refreshes daily and weekly; extra usage at API pricing. Frontier models from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, SpaceXAI plus open-source.
plans.note: windsurf.com/pricing now serves the Devin pricing page (Cognition). Dollar value of the quota is not published.

plans.name: Devin / Windsurf Max
plans.limits: 'Significantly higher quotas' than Pro; unlimited concurrent sessions.
plans.note: Dollar value of the quota is not published.

plans.name: Zed Pro
plans.limits: $5 of tokens included; hosted usage billed at API list +10%. Unlimited edit predictions. Bring-your-own-keys is free on the Personal plan.
plans.note: $5 of hosted tokens at list+10% equals about $4.55 of API-list value. The rest of the $10 buys the editor's hosted services.

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.limits: Higher limits in Antigravity, Jules and AI Studio plus flexible AI credit pool. Bundle includes storage and other Google AI features. $10/mo of Google Cloud credits.
plans.note: Bundle plan: coding is one benefit among many. Intelligence assumes Antigravity serves the latest Gemini (AA lists Gemini 4 Argon).

plans.name: Google AI Ultra
plans.limits: 'Up to 20x' Gemini access; even higher Antigravity and Jules limits; $40/mo Google Cloud credits.
plans.note: The fetched Google page did not render the Ultra price; $249.99 is the last known list price. Verify before relying on it.

watchlist.name: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan
watchlist.why: Pricing page is rendered client-side and could not be read, so no plan price is scored. Models are very strong for the price per AA data.

watchlist.name: Kimi Code
watchlist.why: Plan tiers and prices are behind a client-rendered page (in Chinese); not verified.

watchlist.name: Zed / BYOK and Claude Code API keys
watchlist.why: Pay-as-you-go API use is the 1.0x baseline every plan is compared against.
